entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It utilizes temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It employs tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to achieve significant token reduction and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while offering connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: gbrain serves as an opinionated agent brain that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to synthesize answers. It is designed for multi-user company environments by supporting scoped data access and providing gap analysis with citations.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides a long-term memory workflow focused on retain, recall, and reflect operations. It includes an LLM wrapper for existing agents and offers client SDKs for both Python and Node.js.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library that enables stateful agents through a FastAPI server supporting hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It serves as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes memory implementations.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that achieves sub-millisecond performance using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a dedicated Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context over other data. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant and Redis to manage persistent vector search and structured facts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness designed to help agents manage complex tasks through filesystem-based traces and playbooks. It supports a variety of local and OpenAI-compatible models via Python and TypeScript CLI surfaces.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed store with full-text search metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store data locally in a human-readable way. It integrates with Hermes-compatible tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw using hybrid retrieval powered by BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without the need for API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and vector search to serve agents via MCP and specialized hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes LLM inference by using block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse, saving up to 36% in tokens. It offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem and reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3×.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that avoids vector databases in favor of SQLite with FTS5 search. The project features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It includes a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps and supports an in-process embedded mode by default.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes agents. It manages state and retrieval using a stack of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver specific evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration across major coding agent clients.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep offers reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes and supports automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memories as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for agents like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It is a local-first layer that renders context to assistant-specific files via stdio or SSE MCP servers.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database file to manage agent memories. It prioritizes high-value information through importance-weighted recall and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch operation and memory action performed by the agent.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory featuring pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage tools for searching, updating, and remembering state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle self-directed payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It allows agents to pay for API access or charge for their own services with a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin routes local questions to complete artifacts rather than using standard chunk-based RAG. It registers five native tools for knowledge retrieval and supports optional automated tool-routing note generation via model calls.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It features tools for manual memory storage and utilizes configurable query expansion and result reranking to refine retrieval.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It combines HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval methods to facilitate long-term memory access.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin serves as a private local code memory for repositories, offering both semantic and literal search capabilities. It enables grounded Q&A by providing specific file-and-line citations for its responses over a localhost connection.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during the message compression process.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven methodology for autonomous task execution within software development. It enforces strict TDD and YAGNI principles while integrating with coding harnesses like Claude, Codex, and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system enables the generation of web, mobile, and desktop prototypes through a coding-agent CLI. It supports both macOS and Windows applications and is compatible with Hermes Agent and other CLI executables.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee functions as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It processes data from any format and offers dedicated clients for Rust and TypeScript environments.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped across six industry frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. The library covers 29 security domains and maintains compatibility with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language descriptions and Mermaid text into editable .drawio files using 11 different diagram presets. It features built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates deals through ERC-7710 delegated permissions and x402 payments. It integrates escrow, dispute resolution, and adjudication protocols into a single interface for autonomous transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content using a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table to eliminate detectable AI patterns. It is designed for use with Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw utilizes an agentic evolver to automate skill deduplication and quality improvements across team environments. It synchronizes skill libraries across multiple devices and integrates with Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library features 12 metaskills that preserve state within a local directory for agentskills.io-compatible agents. The skills are available as spec-conformant plugins designed to work natively with Claude Code.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,117 task-specific markdown files that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides 822 professional skills with ready-to-paste exports for assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Powered by TranscriptAPI, this skill enables agents to search YouTube and retrieve data from transcripts, channels, and playlists. It adheres to the Agent Skills format for compatibility with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage and save new skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and reports findings alongside an assessment of potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular skill packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs using Lite or Full modes. It includes a specialized spec review gate that utilizes evaluation models to provide PASS/FAIL feedback.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running agents, this harness manages tasks through a three-level work model and a CLI. It supports structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards to facilitate cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides interoperable skills following the Agent Skills specification for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integration with CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and specialized CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration documentation in Portuguese. All contributions follow the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers official integration for FLUX image and video models, including specialized prompting guidelines. It provides API documentation and code examples for FLUX.1, FLUX.2, and six distinct video generation skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts existing code repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It supports Node.js and Python environments while providing provenance through file and line number citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, and supports commercial transactions via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a workflow language for AI that uses a four-verb system and a single Rust binary to define intent as code. It provides static auditing and generates tamper-evident execution receipts, supporting local-first execution with any model.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It is designed to reduce token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific dependencies or models are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial code reviews by employing three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and exploitability. It triages findings through sandbox execution to verify results and includes a deterministic pre-scan using multiple security linters.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub provides a community platform for browsing, searching, and installing skills using the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It allows an agent to handle system design via the Model Context Protocol while the user executes tasks manually.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, requiring evidence-based verification gates for each stage. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for debugging and a Python-based engine for persistent task state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This multi-agent skill simplifies code in five programming languages using specialized agents for hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It employs a risk-tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. it integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards to address CVE-driven scenarios ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based or agent-driven searches across a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It facilitates the discovery and direct installation of plugins for MCP-compatible clients such as Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It provides a standardized financial layer compatible with Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing AI agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker environments. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to prove a skill actually works as intended.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansions with user interests and provides actionable conclusions through AI analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized utilities for video-to-text transcription, local OCR for privacy-focused document processing, and e-commerce material generation. It includes a 'de-humanizer' for AI text and supports batch processing with brand overlays.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures compatibility by verifying existing project interpreters and handling environment-specific path syntax.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It features tools for managing bounty boards and context acquisition, with 85% of the payout going to the winning human-approved answer.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, and their associated development tools. It supports a variety of licensing models, including MIT, Apache-2.0, and unfree licenses, for integration into Nix-based environments.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line Termux command to install Hermes Agent on Android devices with support for over 200 AI models. It includes a gateway service to manage incoming connections directly from the mobile environment.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH) platforms. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and enables users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible, declarative configuration of Hermes Agent settings and workspace documents. It supports a hybrid skill management system and integrates secure secrets handling via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides monitoring tools for per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with distinct identities and workspaces. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, production-ready deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable production package that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools, offering Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments for offline use.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks within a financial trading context. It supports multiple LLM providers and employs a researcher team to assess insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It supports frameworks such as CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for registry management, security auditing, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale agents into automated teams. It features bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms using multiple model providers and MCP tool integration. It features durable agent memory and visual org charts for delegating agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system provides a Kanban board and review queues to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work. It features live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This framework coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents to manage automated task lifecycles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TerminalBench-2 and TBLite while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for tool-calling and task routing without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a 100% local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, and includes an auto-sync feature to keep the codebase index current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and associated costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit their data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from coding agents like Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Gemini. It exports sessions into self-contained HTML viewers and automatically redacts common authentication headers during the recording process.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, and is compatible with any AI provider that supports markdown or general prompting.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This real-time widget monitors tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and 30+ other tools directly from local paths. It supports multi-device synchronization to track account limits and session details across different hardware.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art via YAML-based configurations, with options ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP and supports providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and an undo function for reversing recent agent changes.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory tools and integrations for frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph across platforms like Slack and VS Code. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It enables seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting localized skills, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This automated installer deploys a complete hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with zero cost, offering support for 29 community plugins categorized across six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that analyzes AI agent configurations and system prompts to flag vague tool descriptions or missing retry budgets. It performs local analysis without API calls and supports SARIF output for integration with GitHub Code Scanning.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by converting SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for wake words and barge-in functionality. It operates locally across 35 languages using Piper and Kokoro without requiring API keys or user accounts.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other command-line tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local coworking application that integrates external agents such as Hermes Agent and Codex into a single environment. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and supports remote access through a WebUI or messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This interface runs the Hermes agent in-process using existing configurations and provides a three-panel layout with integrated file browsing. It enables mobile and browser access to the agent through secure SSH tunneling.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Designed as a desktop companion, this app simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It offers a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard facilitates multi-platform interaction with Hermes Agent, featuring visual workflow builders, Kanban boards, and usage analytics. It manages ten different platform channels, including Slack and WhatsApp, while providing streaming responses and tool traces.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for agent skills and memory.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from thirteen built-in agents, including Hermes and OpenCode, into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agents and provides native clients for both iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native macOS workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for managing sessions and cron jobs. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair, complemented by native Kanban and skill views.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated UI components for memory management and MCP tools.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension links active browser context to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It features a site-aware drafting panel compatible with 31 writing environments and supports session-specific model locking.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage agent tasks and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track token usage and latency. It includes a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a centralized control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and monitoring agent health via the ZOO Swarm Monitor. It features a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and real-time chat with visualization for tool calls and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit designed for tracking session analytics and searchable transcripts across thirteen different agent sources. It prioritizes privacy through local-only data processing and includes live quota burn tracking for Codex and Claude models.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP to provide a desktop-class interface for remote cloud computers.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative terminal user interface (TUI) built with OpenTUI for managing Hermes Agent sessions and profiles. It incorporates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for configuring skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA enables agent management within Telegram using HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports background spawning for up to five concurrent agent instances and features a terminal chat with file attachment support.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or administrative rights to run local or cloud models. It features a dynamic tool maker for Python handlers and provides integrated support for ComfyUI, TTS, and music workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface offers real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes dedicated management tools for skills, cron jobs, and the configuration of MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring-focused dashboard that provides real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only access to environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure execution. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and supports isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports native streaming responses with model switching.
